## Shortcuts

The generated `/manual/shortcuts` page covers every binding by
construction; this section tracks inline `<Shortcut>` mentions in
prose, both directions.

### AU4 shortcuts never mentioned inline

**(ungrouped)**

- `Shift+Space` — Play/Pause from cursor
- `P` — Play/Pause
- `Ctrl+.` — add-label-playing
- `Shift+H` — audio-host
- `Ctrl+Shift+P` — Open pitch and speed dialog
- `Shift+,` — cursor-long-jump-left
- `Shift+.` — cursor-long-jump-right
- `Ctrl+Shift+X` — Cut and close gap (per track)
- `Ctrl+Del` / `Ctrl+Backspace` — Delete and close gap (all tracks)

- `Shift+N` — input-channels
- `Shift+I` — input-device

- `Ctrl+Shift+M` — mix-and-render-to-new-track

- `Alt+Left` — move-to-prev-label
- `Ctrl+U` — mute-all-tracks
- `Ctrl+Alt+U` — mute-tracks
- `D` — next-tool
- `Alt+F6` — Next window
- `Shift+Space` — once-play-stop
- `Shift+O` — output-device
- `Alt+Down` — pitch-down
- `Alt+Up` — pitch-up
- `Shift+F8` — play-after-selection-end
- `Ctrl+Shift+F7` — play-before-and-after-selection-end
- `Ctrl+Shift+F5` — play-before-and-after-selection-start
- `Shift+F7` — play-before-selection-end
- `Shift+F5` — play-before-selection-start
- `C` — play-cut-preview
- `1` — play-one-sec
- `X` — play-stop-select
- `B` — play-to-selection
- `Ctrl+Shift+F6` — prev-frame
- `A` — prev-tool
- `Alt+Shift+F6` — Previous window
- `Alt+Down` — Move realtime effect down
- `Alt+Up` — Move realtime effect up
- `Alt+.` — sel-next-clip
- `Alt+,` — sel-prev-clip
- `Ctrl+Shift+Y` — sel-sync-lock-tracks
- `Ctrl+Shift+A` — select-none
- `Ctrl+]` — skip-sel-end
- `Ctrl+[` — skip-sel-start
- `Ctrl+Alt+I` — split-new
- `Shift+T` — timer-record
- `Return` — toggle
- `NUMPAD_ENTER` — toggle-alt
- `Q` — Toggle spectral selection
- `Shift+C` — track-close
- `Shift+G` — track-gain
- `Alt+Shift+Down` — track-gain-dec
- `Alt+Shift+Up` — track-gain-inc
- `Shift+M` — track-menu
- `Shift+P` — track-pan
- `Ctrl+Shift+U` — unmute-all-tracks
- `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+U` — unmute-tracks
- `Ctrl+2` — zoom-normal
- `Ctrl+E` — zoom-sel

**Keyboard navigation**

- `Ctrl+Tab` — nav-next-tab
- `PgDown` — nav-nextrow-control
- `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` — nav-prev-tab
- `PgUp` — nav-prevrow-control

**Trackedit actions**

- `Shift+V` — Paste (pushes clips on selected track)
- `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V` — Paste (preserves synchronization on all tracks)
- `Ctrl+Alt+V` — Paste (overlaps other clips)

**Tracks view navigation actions**

- `Ctrl+Home` — First track
- `Ctrl+End` — Last track
- `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+Return` — Track range selection
- `Ctrl+Enter` / `Ctrl+Return` — Add track or track item to selection
